name: Guest/host address identity required with no translation layer and no stated address
required_postconditions: the address the allocator returns is the address the guest asked for, with no translation layer in between

failure_sink.description: the case reports `relocated`: mmap returned SUCCESS at a different address, and a caller requiring identity has no error to check

extraction_limitations: Single-claim contract written to pair with a ground-truth case. It asserts exactly one thing so that a whole-contract verdict can be compared against a single observation without ambiguity.
x_groundtruth: The same unsound assumption as the hinted case, stated without an address. RS-VM-0008 is about the assumption itself; RS-VM-0007 is about a specific hint. Keeping both means neither rule loses its only execution when the other contract is edited.
